##: The zip is a PyInstaller onedir tree compressed whole, so `flow` is a directory
inside it and the exe is at `flow\flow.exe` rather than at the root. No
`extract_dir` here on purpose: the archive is unpacked as it is, which keeps every
path below identical to the path inside the zip, so one reading of
`hash` is a placeholder until a release exists to hash. packaging/PUBLISHING.md
has the one-liner that fills it; the manifest will not install until it is filled.
`autoupdate.hash` reads the `.sha256` the release workflow now uploads beside the
zip, so a version bump does not have to download 126 MB to learn one number.
